# OPUS-MT English → Vietnamese (redistributed, unmodified)

- Model: Helsinki-NLP `opus-mt-en-vi` (Tatoeba-Challenge eng-vie, transformer-align), © Language Technology Research Group, University of Helsinki. Licence: Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE`).
- ONNX export: `Xenova/opus-mt-en-vi`, revision `30bcd461c0d7338ad106b36314d3eedc2d4e998c` (int8 "quantized" files).
- Files are byte-identical to that revision; only the file names carry an extra `.bin` suffix so the CDN caches them.
  SHA-256 of every file: `../MANIFEST.sha256` (checked by `frontend/scripts/test-listening-translator.mjs`).
- Used by English Coach Listening to translate transcript lines on the learner's own device; no server inference.
